title: ECoG during a simple auditory reaction-time task, 8 subjects: stimulus-locked, response-locked and rest epochs at 400 Hz (Cho et al., physiological origin of ERPs)
description: Electrocorticography (ECoG) recordings from eight human subjects performing a simple auditory reaction-time task, in which they pressed a button as quickly as possible after an auditory stimulus. This derivative dataset contains the authors' downsampled (400 Hz) stimulus-locked, response-locked, and rest epochs, repackaged in iEEG-BIDS. The data support investigation of the physiological origin of event-related potentials.
methods_description: Subjects performed a simple reaction-time task with a button press after an auditory stimulus. Channels were excluded and data downsampled to 400 Hz. Epochs were extracted around the stimulus (-1.0 to +1.5 s) and the button press (-1.5 to +1.5 s), plus 1-s rest segments used as baseline.
